title: My alarm failed to go off
body:
Issue: My alarm failed to go off at its scheduled time.

We are so sorry that this happened. To help diagnose the issue, please test the alarm that failed by adjusting its time for a minute or two from now, making sure it is toggled on and then locking your iPhone. Note whether it fires as expected or the issue occurs again, then reach out to us using the contact button below. Be sure to include as much context as you can about your alarm settings and what is happening.

Some common bases to cover:

Make sure no other alarms are scheduled at the exact same time, either from your iPhone's Clock app or other third-party alarm apps. When two alarms are set for the exact same minute, they can cancel each other out. If you'd like to schedule backup alarms in the Clock app, be sure that they are at least a few minutes after your Lasso alarm.

Ensure your volume is set to a reasonable level. If you don't respond to the alarm after a considerable period of time, the alarm will stay on the screen but the audio will go silent.

Consider using the 'Next Alarm' Lock Screen widget for easy confirmation that your alarm is toggled on and set to the expected time.
